lines.en: Eva, I’m supposed to be at work by nine, but the train was late again, and the meeting starts in ten minutes.
lines.pt: Eva, eu devo estar no trabalho às nove, mas o trem atrasou de novo e a reunião começa em dez minutos.

lines.en: Don’t worry. The manager isn’t supposed to arrive before half past, so we still have time to prepare the room.
lines.pt: Não se preocupe. O gerente não deve chegar antes das nove e meia, então ainda temos tempo de preparar a sala.

lines.en: Good. Who is supposed to bring the projector? I thought the assistant was supposed to book it yesterday.
lines.pt: Bom. Quem deve trazer o projetor? Achei que a assistente devia reservá-lo ontem.

lines.en: She was supposed to, but she was off sick. I picked one up from the storeroom this morning.
lines.pt: Devia, mas ela estava de licença médica. Peguei um no depósito hoje de manhã.

lines.en: Thank you. By the way, the agenda says we’re supposed to discuss the budget first, which will take forever.
lines.pt: Obrigado. A propósito, a pauta diz que devemos discutir o orçamento primeiro, o que vai demorar uma eternidade.

lines.en: I know. Everybody is supposed to read the report beforehand, but half of the team never does.
lines.pt: Eu sei. Todos devem ler o relatório antes, mas metade da equipe nunca lê.

lines.en: Well, I read it on the train. The figures were supposed to be final, but I found two mistakes on page four.
lines.pt: Bem, li no trem. Os números deviam ser finais, mas encontrei dois erros na página quatro.

lines.en: Two mistakes? We’d better tell the manager right away, or the whole presentation will look careless.
lines.pt: Dois erros? É melhor avisarmos o gerente agora mesmo, ou a apresentação inteira vai parecer descuidada.

lines.en: Agreed. Also, are we supposed to wear suits today? The client is visiting after lunch, and I’m in jeans.
lines.pt: Combinado. Também, devemos usar terno hoje? O cliente visita depois do almoço, e estou de jeans.

lines.en: Nobody told me about a dress code, but you could borrow my spare jacket from the office cupboard.
lines.pt: Ninguém me falou de um código de vestimenta, mas você pode pegar meu casaco reserva do armário do escritório.

lines.en: You’re a lifesaver. Let’s fix the slides first, and then I’ll change before the manager comes in.
lines.pt: Você é uma salvadora. Vamos corrigir os slides primeiro, e depois me troco antes de o gerente entrar.

facts.label: Regras e expectativas
facts.sub: I’m supposed to be at work by nine. She was supposed to book it.

facts.label: was/were supposed to
facts.sub: No passado, was/were supposed to indica o que deveria ter acontecido: She was supposed to book the projector. Muitas vezes sugere que não aconteceu como planejado.

facts.label: isn’t supposed to
facts.sub: A negativa diz que algo não é esperado: The manager isn’t supposed to arrive early. Em perguntas, use be: Are we supposed to wear suits? Não use do.

compare.ask: I’m supposed to be at work by nine.
compare.br: No Brasil, dizemos “eu devia estar lá” e “ele não devia chegar antes”.
compare.tip: Diga: “I’m supposed to be at work by nine.”
compare.us: Em inglês: I was supposed to be there; he isn’t supposed to arrive early. Be supposed to mostra regra ou plano, não só opinião.

solo: Peça uma experiência pessoal do aluno com essa diferença.
group: Leia as duas colunas e peça que apontem a maior diferença.

extra90: Dupla: um fala como no Brasil, o outro como nos EUA.

pages.title: Mito ou fato? · 1/2

items.s: Be supposed to talks about expectations or rules.
We say “I suppose to be there”.
items.why: We say I’m supposed to be there.

items.s: Was supposed to can mean it did not happen.

pages.instruction: Decida e explique com suas palavras.

solo: Aluno responde e justifica; você mostra a pista.
group: Cada aluno decide sozinho, depois compare as respostas e peça uma justificativa.
Corrija pela pista do texto, não só dizendo “certo/errado”.
extra90: Peça que cada aluno invente uma pergunta igual para o colega.
answers: Be supposed to talks about expectations or rules. → Verdadeiro (Yes.)
We say “I suppose to be there”. → Falso (We say I’m supposed to be there.)
Was supposed to can mean it did not happen. → Verdadeiro (Yes.)

pages.title: Before the meeting · 1/3
paragraphs: It is a busy morning in Chicago. Cal rushes into the office building. The meeting room is still empty. Eva sets chairs around a long table. A clock on the wall shows ten to nine. They have almost no time.

“Eva, I’m supposed to be at work by nine, but the train was late again, and the meeting starts in ten minutes.” says Cal. “Don’t worry. The manager isn’t supposed to arrive before half past, so we still have time to prepare the room.” says Eva. “Good. Who is supposed to bring the projector? I thought the assistant was supposed to book it yesterday.” says Cal.
